blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (Any signed-in user reads any organization's invoice by id) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Insecure direct object reference (CWE-639 / CWE-862). A user of organization 7 sends `GET /invoices/42` and gets invoice 42 of another organization: the handler never calls `currentUser(req)` and the query filters on `id` only, so ids can be enumerated to read every customer's invoices (number, total, date). Scope the query to the caller's organization — `WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2` with `[id, currentUser(req).orgId]` — so a foreign id answers 404, and add a test asserting the org filter, like the list endpoint's test.
findings.title: Any signed-in user reads any organization's invoice by id

findings.recommendation: Information exposure through an error message (CWE-209). Any request that makes a handler throw — e.g. a database failure while serving `GET /invoices` — answers the client with the raw error message (pg errors can carry SQL fragments, table and constraint names, connection details) and the server stack trace with file paths and dependency versions. Log the error server-side as is done, and answer only a generic body such as `{ error: "internal error" }`.
findings.title: Error handler returns the error message and stack trace to the client
